payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the SATA-LSTM and SATA Tree-LSTM models against various baseline models, including syntactic tree-based models and other neural models.

claims.text: The SATA-LSTM was compared against neural models built on both syntactic trees and latent trees, as well as non-tree models.
The SATA Tree-LSTM showed superior or competitive performance compared to previous syntactic tree-based models and other neural models.
The SATA Tree-LSTM outperformed recent latent tree-based models, indicating its competitive edge in the tree-structured model class.
